notes: §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.1: "If the literal is restricted to a numeric literal, the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES)." In a numeric operand position NonNumericInNumericContext returns the number 0 for the zero word (through ZeroOperand) and reports COBOL0844 for every other figurative constant, an ALL literal and a symbolic-character included (BindPrimary words the symbolic-character case); in the VALUE clause of a numeric item or of a condition-name on one, ValidateValueCategory reports COBOL1657. The edition arm is the ALL form: 2023 adds "without the ALL phrase", and GateAllZeroAsNumeric asks the registry row figurative-all-zero-numeric-removed-2002, which is silent at 85, where §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.3 makes the word ALL "redundant", and COBOL0902 from 2002. Probed at --std 85 over 18 figurative spellings in 20 positions (ADD, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE with and without GIVING, COMPUTE, an arithmetic expression in a relation and a sign condition, PERFORM VARYING FROM and BY, a function argument, a reference modifier, VALUE on DISPLAY and COMP items and on a level 88 with THRU): ZERO, ZEROS, ZEROES and their ALL forms are accepted everywhere but PERFORM VARYING BY, where the zero step is refused by its own rule (COBOL2120), and SPACE(S), HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUES, QUOTE, their ALL forms, ALL "1", ALL "12" and a symbolic-character with and without ALL are refused in every position. The witness is ADD SPACE TO X, refused with COBOL0844.

next.reason: 1985: "the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES)."; 2023: "the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES) without the ALL phrase.". Same rule, but 2023 adds an explicit refusal of ALL ZERO where a numeric literal is required. The 1985 text does not exclude the ALL form.
